_설명: 채널 배역 목소리. 영상마다 인물을 이 배역 중 하나에 배정한다(같은 배역 = 같은 목소리라 시청자가 '왕이구나·악당이구나' 알아봄). voice = Google TTS 목소리, rate = 속도, pitch = 반음 후처리(기계음 잡음이 생겨서 0으로 둠 - 성격은 목소리 고르기·억양·속도로), fx = 울림 효과(동굴처럼 들려서 안 씀, 빈칸). 다시 만들기: .venv/bin/python -I audio/cast.py [배역키...] 속도: 채널 규칙상 느린 목소리 금지 - 내레이터 1.07(2026-10-20 사용자: 1.19는 빠름, 10% 느리게), 다른 배역도 1.0 이상(2026-10-20). direction = Gemini 연기 지시(인물 대사는 Gemini 3.8/3.1로 연기, 무료 한도가 막히면 Chirp로 대신).

narrator.line: In 1206, every tribe on the steppe swore loyalty to one man. The world was about to change.

narrator2.line: In 1206, every tribe on the steppe swore loyalty to one man. The world was about to change.

king.line: Kneel. From this day there is one law under the Eternal Blue Sky. And it is mine.
king.direction: A mighty ruler giving orders: deep, heavy, regal, absolute authority, controlled power.

general.line: Hold the line! Archers, wait for my signal... Now! Loose!
general.direction: A battle-hardened commander: gruff, loud, urgent, barking orders over the noise of battle.

villain.line: Let them run. Let them hide. In the end, every city opens its gates to me.
villain.direction: A menacing villain: low, cold, close to a whisper, with a cruel smile in the voice.

schemer.line: Of course, Your Majesty. I would never betray you. Never... ever.
schemer.direction: A sly, two-faced schemer: smooth, oily, flattering, quietly scheming.

clown.line: Wait, wait, wait! I'm the commander here! Why is everyone listening to him?!
clown.direction: A panicking, self-important braggart: whiny, outraged, voice cracking higher.

hero.line: They left us here to die. Fine. Then I'll survive. And one day, they'll all remember my name.
hero.direction: A determined young hero: fierce, defiant, intense, full of conviction.

sage.line: An empire won on horseback, my lord, cannot be ruled from horseback.
sage.direction: A wise old advisor: calm, measured, knowing, a little weary.

commoner.line: Please, we're just farmers. We have nothing left to give you.
commoner.direction: A frightened ordinary villager: pleading, shaky, desperate.

messenger.line: My lord! The enemy has crossed the river. Ten thousand riders, maybe more!
messenger.direction: A breathless messenger who just rode in: urgent, alarmed, out of breath.

queen.line: My husband is dead. Until his son comes of age, this empire answers to me.
queen.direction: A commanding queen: cool, composed, regal, steel under silk.

mother.line: Listen to me. Brothers who fight each other get eaten by the wolves, one by one.
mother.direction: A fierce, protective mother scolding her sons: stern, emotional, strong.

maiden.line: They took me in the night. But I knew he would come for me.
maiden.direction: A brave young woman: emotional but resolute.

witch.line: Poison, they say, is a coward's weapon. How fortunate that I am no coward... and no fool.
witch.direction: A cold, calculating female villain: silky, amused, dangerous.

boy.line: Mother... Father isn't coming back, is he?
boy.direction: A frightened young boy: small trembling voice, holding back tears.
